name: iredis
description: iredis — interactive Redis CLI with autocomplete, syntax highlighting, and a full-featured REPL. Execute Redis commands directly from the terminal with JSON and raw output modes.

install_guidance.note: Also available via brew install iredis. Supports Redis URLs, DSN aliases, TLS, SSH tunnels, and NAT maps. Use --raw for clean machine-parseable output.

commands.description: Execute one or more Redis commands non-interactively (passthrough: iredis [CMD...] [--raw] [--url <url>] [-h <host>] [-p <port>])

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install iredis: pip install iredis. Requires a running Redis server.

commands.description: Passthrough to iredis for interactive REPL or any arguments not covered
